subpoints.text: Benedict Arnold helped win the Battles of Saratoga. He was seriously wounded during the fighting. Afterward, he never felt that he got the credit he deserved. He also disagreed with the way the Continental Congress was leading the war. So, he offered to join the British in exchange for a large amount of money.
